title.en: Broadcasting (Exemption of Broadcasting Services by Educational Institutions) Order 2010

completenessNote: 全文，共 6 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Broadcasting (Exemption of Broadcasting Services by Educational Institutions) Order 2010 and shall come into operation on 16th September 2010.

heading.en: Exemption for educational institution broadcasting service

text.en: 3. Every educational institution shall be exempt from section 8 of the Act in relation to all or any exempt broadcasting service provided by that educational institution, subject to the terms and conditions specified in paragraph 4.

heading.en: Order does not affect other written law

text.en: 5. Nothing in this Order shall be construed to limit or in any way affect the operation of any other written law.

THE SCHEDULE
Paragraph 2
Exempt Broadcasting Services
1. Special interest television services transmitted through an educational institution’s closed Internet protocol network.
2. Special interest radio services transmitted through an educational institution’s closed Internet protocol network.
3. Special interest radio services transmitted through an educational institution’s public address system.
